content.text: {"headline":"Approve no action (P0): service is predicted at 88.8% for 13:45-20:00, above the 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"General has run 29% above forecast all day (1,826 calls vs 1,412). The last two intervals were the highest, at +57% and +51%. The rise is spread across normal call reasons, and no incident, campaign or absence explains it. Even so, current staffing is predicted to hold 88.8% overall (general 85.7%, payments 91.9%) with 2.3% abandons, so no plan is needed to meet the target. This is the cheapest option that follows policy and reaches 80%.","trade_offs":["P2 (chat deflection, ₹384) lifts service to 90.1% and cuts abandons to 1.9%. It does this by pushing some balance, offer and refund callers to chat.","P3 (overtime, ₹4,500) gives the best result at 92.0%, with general at 91.3% and abandons at 1.7%. It costs far more for a target already being met.","P4 (₹1,668) reaches 90.2%. It moves 2 agents off payments, which drops payments to 90.9%.","P1 (₹450) actually lowers service to 87.9%, because pulling agents and adding callback on payments drops payments to 89.8%. It isn't worth doing."],"watch":"The surge is unexplained and was still climbing in the last two intervals. General has the least headroom at 85.7%. If arrivals keep rising, move quickly to P2 deflection, the cheap uplift, or to overtime. If a cause such as an outage appears, re-diagnose."}
